blocks.text: The Elysium, where are seen arches covered with flowers, groves, fountains and green meadows, where repose the shades of the blessed, divided into different groups.
One of them covered with a long veil is followed by many others.
Air and Chorus of the followers of EURYDICE.

lines: Is the sweet abode of peace,
Naught here doth grieve the mind,
The breeze is soft and pure,
A sweet softness enraptures our feelings,
Where peace sits as on its throne.
How brilliantly here shines the sun,
I never saw the sky so pure,
I never saw the day so clear,
And the sweet breath of the air!
But the calm that reigns here round
Oh thou, sweet object of my love,
The pangs of my sad heart.
To see thee, to hear thy voice,
To inhale the air thou breathest,
This is the only bliss to which I aim.
My sweet sighs. If you knew
The flame that is kindled in my heart,
And to your wishes heaven friendly smiles.

blocks.text: The Shades, ORPHEUS, and EURYDICE veiled, at a distance.
During the following chorus the Shades lead EURYDICE to ORPHEUS, who receives her without looking at her, but showing the greatest transport of love and joy.

lines: That never more you should be parted.
Do not complain of your fate
That the love of such a consort
May be called a real Elysium.

blocks.text: The shades follow ORPHEUS and EURYDICE.
